name: Robert Maxwell
bio:
Robert Maxwell is a seasoned finance controller with over 20 years of experience managing complex budgets and financial strategies. His entry into motorsport was somewhat accidental, initially offering his financial consulting services to a small IndyCar team to help restructure their debt. He was immediately drawn to the high-stakes, fast-paced environment and the dedication of the people involved.

At Tolman Motorsport, Robert is known for his meticulous approach and ability to identify hidden opportunities within the financial data. He believes in a transparent and data-driven approach to financial management, ensuring that every decision is backed by solid analysis. He is particularly skilled at forecasting and risk management, allowing the team to make informed decisions that balance performance gains with financial stability. Robert's lone wolf tendencies allow him to focus intensely on the numbers, but can sometimes lead to miscommunication with other departments.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: Robert is a man of medium build with a focused gaze and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn financial calculator.
Insists on using only analog clocks in his office.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
